description: This file is a shell script containing various functions related to git operations such as tagging, commit creation, ref updating, symbol replacement, setting author info, and date manipulation. It appears to be a utility script used for automating or managing git repositories.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies existence of a given git tag.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Generates a unique git commit with specified text and tree.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Updates a git tag reference with new commit info and modifies sed.script accordingly.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces sha1 hashes in input with symbolic references using sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Executes commands with a specified GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL environment variable temporarily set.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Retrieves the commit timestamp for a given commit hash.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date to a variable, with default fallback.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs commands with a specific commit date set.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs commands with both author and committer dates set.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Executes a command suppressing its error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Checks command output against expected result, manages temporary files.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Creates a sanitized test name from description text.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Wraps a test execution expecting success, manages expected and actual output files.
